uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The $180.30 figure stacks marginal p99 components and is not a joint p99 probability.
The stress model can double-count visible depth and realized slippage for one execution.
Stop gaps, mark outages, liquidation cascades, and changed funding can exceed the modeled loss.
The actual account value is point-in-time and will change with deposits, withdrawals, fees, funding, and realized PnL.
Sizing arithmetic does not establish strategy edge, signal frequency, or co-trigger probability.
falsifiers: Any referenced immutable source hash or byte count fails reconciliation.
The final approved profile changes sizing, routes, stop contracts, or asset membership.
